items.title: Randy Brecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 12, 2022
items.q: it was a fantastic band — Billy Cobham fresh out of the Army on drums, John B. Williams who was a student of Ron Carter’s then but he was a great bass player

ctx.x: How much older — can you recall how much older was Horace Silver than you at the time?

Well he was in his — I was — let me see how old was I — 21 or so, and he was in his 40s. He was around twenty years — but you know it was a fantastic band — Billy Cobham fresh out of the Army on drums, John B. Williams who was a student of Ron Carter’s then but he was a great bass player and still very active, and the great Bennie Maupin on tenor saxophone. So I couldn’t have asked for more — and the band — and I really developed quickly in that kind of circumstance on the other side of the coin.
Did it help your compositional approach to play in that band?
